C0462.title: Woman Arrested for Defrauding Nearly ¥1M with Fake Transfer Screenshots
C0462.summary: In September 2022, Jinjiang police cracked a fraud case involving fake transfer screenshots. The suspect, surnamed Zhou, sent a counterfeit transfer screenshot to a trading company owner under the guise of purchasing shortening, defrauding goods worth ¥14,250.
